verdict.rationale: Thoropass docs describe automatic, integration-based evidence collection ('collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations') via auditor-vetted native integrations and a centralized Monitors page for audit readiness, explicitly replacing manual spreadsheets/version control. This matches the story's core claim of scheduled, machine-gathered evidence rather than manual screenshots/CSVs. Missing for 10: explicit mention of collection schedule/cadence, timestamping of artifacts, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
